s: Dine bittul reshut ubo z' seipim: echad mibbene hechatzer sheshshakach velo ereb immahem — oser alehem. Mah taqqanatam? Yebattel lahem reshut sheyyesh lo bechatzer, sheyyomar "reshuti mebuttelet lakem" o "reshuti qenuya lakem". Veen tzarik liqnot beqinyan sudar. Veyakol lebattel mishshettechshak. Veap al pi sheen qonin qinyan beshabbat, mikkol maqom kan en tzarik sheyyiqnu hem reshuto, ella shehu yesalleq atzmo mereshuto, umimmela en mi sheyyeesor alehem; ulesalleq atzmo mereshuto muttar ap beshabbat. Veim dar im d' o Hashem — tzarik lebattel lekol echad veechad, sheyyomar "reshuti mebuttelet lekullekem", velo day sheyyebattel leechad mehem, ap al pi shezzeh shemmebattel lo kebar ereb im hashshear. Veim lo asa ken, ap lemi shebbittel lo asur. Veyesh omerim shello day sheyyomar "reshuti mebuttelet lekullekem", ella tzarik sheyyeparesh veyomar "mebuttelet leka uleka". Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim halek achar hammeqel:

Im bittel lahem reshuto setam — lo bittel ella reshut sheyyesh lo bechatzer. Lepikak hem muttarim lehotzi mibbattehem lechatzer vegam hu, lepi shehu naaseh etzlam keoreach bealma. Abal asurim lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer veken lehaknis, shehare beto hu meyuchad lo vehechatzer lahem, vahare zeh motzi mereshut lirshut. Vaapillu hu, shebbeto shello vegam bechatzer hu keoreach etzlam, ap al pi ken asur lo lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer (veken lehaknis), lepi sheen omerim shehu keoreach etzlam ella leinyan tashmish mibbattehem lechatzer, abal tashmish shemmibbeto o lebeto — en lomar shehu oreach. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik linol beto, kede shello yabo lehotzi beissur, velo yiptachennu ella kesherotzeh latzet velabo, veyinalennu miyyad achar tzeto uboo. Vehammeqel lo hipsid, ki yesh lo al mi lismok:

Im bittel lahem gam reshut beto — muttarim gam bebeto lehotzi mimmennu lechatzer veken lehaknis kemo bebattehem, vegam hu muttar bebeto kemo bebattehem, lepi shennaaseh oreach gamur etzlam, kevan shello nishar lo shum reshut shello bittela lahem. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yotzi mibbeto lechatzer qodem sheyyotziu [he]m mibbattehem lechatzer, kede sheyyachaziqu hem bechatzer techilla, velo yaknis mechatzer lebeto qodem sheyyaknisu hem mechatzer lebeto, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"a:

Im eno rotzeh lebattel lahem reshuto, ella lehaskiro — yesh omerim shessekirut moelet beyisrael kemo shemmoelet benokri, lepi shehassekirut enah garua mehabbittul shehi mattana bechinnam. Veyesh omerim shello tiqqenu sekirut ella benokri sheen bittulo moil, abal lo beyisrael. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Im bene hechatzer sheerebu mebattelin reshutam leechad shello ereb immahem — hu muttar lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer, velo mibbattehem, ella im ken bittelu lo beperush gam reshut battehem. Vehem asurim apillu mibbeto lechatzer. Veap al pi shershut echad hen leachar shebbitteluhu lo, mikkol maqom kevan shechatzer zo hayeta shellahem, im ken keshechozerin umotziim letokah hare zeh keillu chozerim bahem verotzim lizkot bah, sheen lomar shehem mishtammeshim bah keorechim bealma, lepi sheharabbim legabbe yachid enan domin keorechim etzlo. Vaapillu im kebar hecheziq hu bechatzer — en zeh moil shello yukelu harabbim lachazor bahem. Abal muttarim lehaknis mechatzer lebeto, lepi sheen nireh chazara ella keshemmaknisim lirshut shellahem shebbitteluha, dehaynu lechatzer, abal keshemmotziim mereshut zo umaknisim lirshut acheret — en zo niret chazara. Abal asurim lehaknis mechatzer lebattehem apillu im bittelu lo gam reshut battehem, shennaasa hakkol reshut echad shello — mikkol maqom kevan shehem enan keorechim legabbe hayyachid, im ken keshemmaknisim lebattehem hare zeh keillu chozerim vezokim bebattehem. Veen tzarik lomar sheasurim lehotzi mibbattehem lechatzer apillu bittelu lo gam reshut battehem, kemo sheasurim lehotzi apillu mibbeto mammash lechatzer:

Veken im hayu shenayim lebad darim bechatzer velo erebu, ubittel echad mehem lachabero — dino kerabbim legabbe yachid, sheap hayyachid eno naaseh oreach legabbe yachid ella legabbe rabbim, veen rabbim pechutim mishshenayim. Veken rabbim shello erebu shebbittelu reshutam lerabbim sheerebu, enam naasim orechim etzlam, vedinam kerabbim legabbe yachid:

Rabbim shello erebu yekolim lebattel reshutam ben leyachid shello ereb ben lerabbim sheerebu benehem, ubilbad shekkol echad mehambattelim yebattel lekol echad mehem, kemo shennitbaer lemala beyachid hambattel. Abal lerabbim shello erebu, apillu lishnayim shello erebu — en mebattelin lahem, ben shehambattelim hem rabbim sheerebu ben shehu yachid shello ereb, shehare ap leachar sheyyebattelu lahem hem shenayim, veechad oser al chabero. Vaapillu im chazar haechad ubittel lachabero — eno moil kelum, shekkevan shebbeshaa shebbittelu harishonim hechatzer lezeh hachozer umebattel lo haya lo az bah zekut shel hetter tiltul, mippene sheoserim zeh al zeh, im ken bittul zeh lo hoil kelum, ukeshechozer umebattel lezeh eno yakol lebattel reshut shellahem, shehare lo zaku bah. Vaapillu keshebbittelo lo harishonim ameru lo "anu mebattelim leka al menat shettachazor utebattel lachabereka", shennatenu lahem reshut lebattel lo — eno moil kelum, shekkevan shello zaka becheleq shebbittelu lo beinyan sheyyukal letaltel bechatzer, eno yakol lehaqnot lachabero:
